title: Prospective machine-learning screen identifies six previously unreported OATP1B1 inhibitors
summary: Researchers trained and compared seven machine-learning classifiers for OATP1B1 transporter inhibition. In prospective CHO-cell testing, 15 of 19 compounds predicted active by SVC models inhibited the transporter; six (abamectin, asiaticoside, berbamine, doramectin, mobocertinib and umbralisib) were described as previously unreported OATP1B1 inhibitors.
ai_technology: Seven molecular-fingerprint machine-learning classifiers, with prospective selection by support vector classifier (SVC)

evidence.tested: In prospective CHO-cell testing, 15 of 19 compounds predicted active by SVC models inhibited the transporter; six (abamectin, asiaticoside, berbamine, doramectin, mobocertinib and umbralisib) were described as previously unreported OATP1B1 inhibitors.
evidence.unknown: The 84% refers to a small prospective test set of 19 compounds, and transporter inhibition was measured in vitro in engineered CHO cells. These findings flag possible drug–drug interaction liability; they do not show clinical interaction or patient outcome. The authors qualify six inhibitors as appearing novel at publication.
evidence.ai_role: Models trained on in-vitro OATP1B1 inhibition data ranked compounds for prospective testing. Researchers tested 19 model-selected compounds in transporter-expressing CHO cells and observed inhibition for 15, including six compounds the authors described as novel OATP1B1 inhibitors.
